_comment: Baseline-flow footprint of the portfolio: which nodes and links the placed companies' intervention locations touch, and how much baseline flow (NOT avoided emissions) runs through them in each scenario. Values are deduped by construction — the subflow rows every company's location touches are unioned before rollup, so an edge two companies both reach is counted once. `touched_by` lists the contributing company slugs (empty = untouched, values null). Two cautions: (1) never sum values across links — the table spans 7 levels, so a total over every link multi-counts by roughly the number of level cuts; read one level cut at a time. (2) Coverage is already high and approaches total as companies are placed, so the signal is in `touched_by` and the value magnitudes, not in the mere presence of an edge.
